# TripLink
> Modern global cross-border payments and virtual commercial card issuing platform for businesses, travel, education, and advertising use cases.

TripLink provides virtual commercial cards and customizable card issuance solutions for global payments, with products focused on employee expenses, travel, study abroad, and Amazon Ads spending.

## Core Product
- [Home](https://triplinkintl.com/): Overview of TripLink’s virtual commercial card platform and global payment capabilities.
- [Virtual Commercial Card for Global Payments](https://triplinkintl.com/): Main product page describing cross-border payment and card issuing solutions.
- [Customizable Card Issuance Solutions](https://triplinkintl.com/): Highlights configurable card issuance, card design, and payment experience features.
- [Flexible Card Management](https://triplinkintl.com/): Describes controls and management options for issued virtual commercial cards.
- [Wide Range Selection of Card Type](https://triplinkintl.com/): Covers available card type options for different payment scenarios.
- [Customized Card Design](https://triplinkintl.com/): Explains branding and design customization for issued cards.
- [Precise Transaction Control](https://triplinkintl.com/): Details transaction controls and spending management capabilities.

## Industry Solutions
- [Global Leading Industry Solutions](https://triplinkintl.com/): Overview of TripLink’s payment solutions across multiple business verticals.
- [Employee Expense](https://triplinkintl.com/): Solution for managing employee spending with virtual commercial cards.
- [Travel](https://triplinkintl.com/): Payment solution tailored for travel-related bookings and operational expenses.
- [Study Abroad](https://triplinkintl.com/): Cross-border payment support for education and study abroad scenarios.
- [Amazon Ads](https://triplinkintl.com/): Card-based payment solution for managing Amazon advertising spend.

## Business Use Cases
- [Business Expense Management](https://triplinkintl.com/): Using virtual cards to streamline employee and operational expenses.
- [Travel Payments](https://triplinkintl.com/): Managing supplier, booking, and travel-related payment flows.
- [Education Payments](https://triplinkintl.com/): Supporting tuition, fees, and related international education payments.
- [Advertising Spend Management](https://triplinkintl.com/): Controlling and funding digital advertising payments with virtual cards.
